methods.recipe: Egg Cream Pop Rock Wafer Sandwiches
methods.method:
prep: Heat oven to 325°F; line sheets with parchment
creamed = cream until fluffy, 2 min <- Butter + Granulated Sugar
wet = beat in until smooth <- creamed + Whole Milk + Vanilla Extract
dry = whisk <- Flour + Dutch-Process Cocoa Powder + Baking Soda + Salt @wafer
dough = mix on low just until a dough forms <- wet + dry
sheets = roll 1/16 in. between parchment; chill 30 min <- dough
wafers = cut 2 in. rounds (48), re-roll scraps; bake 325°F ~14 min until dry and fully crisp; cool completely <- sheets
melted = melt gently (≤110°F); sift in milk powder, whisk smooth <- Chocolate, White + Cocoa Butter + Nonfat Milk Powder + Salt @creme
cooled = cool, stirring now and then, to 75–78°F, thick and setting at the edges, ~20 min <- melted
whipped = whip until pale and fluffy, 3–5 min <- cooled
creme = fold in at the last minute <- whipped + Popping Candy (unflavored)
pipe ~16 g creme on 24 wafers, top with the rest, press gently; set 15 min; store airtight <- wafers + creme
methods.notes: Wafers crisp further as they cool; if any center flexes once cool, return to the oven 2–3 min. The creme is a water-free whipped white chocolate (cocoa butter instead of water), so the popping candy keeps its pop and the wafers stay crisp. No vanilla in the creme: even a little extract can seize melted white chocolate. If it won't whip, it's too warm: chill 5 min and try again; if it goes stiff, warm the bowl briefly. Freeze airtight; thaw in the sealed container so condensation forms on the box, not the cookies.
